goal: Dynamically compute headers presync DoS parameters at startup instead of baking them into releases
Remove manual release-prep parameter generation and prevent protection from drifting as software ages
Correct an attack model flaw where an attacker stops mid-batch
agreement: Strong support with no open blocking objections (darosior, l0rinc)
Verified the calculation from scratch and favored the simpler approach and bounds tradeoff (darosior)
Nonblocking suggestion: defer calculation until after clock checks to handle wrong startup clocks (l0rinc)
Suggested doc, magic number, and test record cleanups (hodlinator)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because dynamically computing DoS parameters at node startup prevents defense drift as software ages
Addresses a flaw in the prior model that failed to account for attackers strategically aborting mid-batch
